_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Nga mwenye kucheza {player_id} mu michezo ya Liar's Dice ya bacheza {num_players}.
Mikano:
- Pa zamu yako, ungashinakila ukulanda:
  1) Kukolwa kwa bid mpya na wingi mwingi au uso mwinshi (panono yote mbili) kuliko bid iliyopo; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kuita bid iliyopita kwa kuandika '[Call]'.

Uka ita:
  - Uka nambari ya kweli ya thamani ya uso miongoni mwa dice zote ni chini ya bid, mcheza wa mwisho wa kukolwa anapoteza die moja.
  - Ulishi, mcheza wa ita anapoteza die moja.
Mcheza afikila 0 dice anatolewa. Mcheza wa mwisho aliyebaki akalusha.

board.new_round:
Mupindi upya - Mabokoshi yaliyobaki: {dice_summary}
Bokoshi bwa kubombelela: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mcheza {current_player_id} aitisa! Nambari ya kweli ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, iyo ni CHINI ya {quantity}.
Mcheza {loser_id} (mcheza wa mwisho wa kukolwa) anapoteza die moja.
call.caller_loses:
Mcheza {current_player_id} aitisa! Nambari ya kweli ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, iyo ni >= {quantity}.
Mcheza {loser_id} (mcheza wa ita) anapoteza die moja.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Inshing'ilo ishikwete ukutambulwa kwati ni '[Bid: X, Y]' kapena '[Call]' icasho. Inshing'ilo iliyosumwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Icipimo cipya {new_quantity} calicepa ukucila ica nomba {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Icipimo cipya {new_face_value} cili pa nshi ya cipo ca nomba {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Icipendo ca pa nshi cifwile ukuba cimo cine ne cipimo ico balepanga pali ilya nshita.
bid_reason.face_range: Icicindeme ca cilambu cilingile ukuba pakati ka 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Umulayi {player_id} alifumishiwe pa mulandu wa kutaluka.
